revision_candidate.required_inputs: AMD SPEC title/revision, tool package/hash/license, supported platform, exact steps/commands/targets, state changes, duration/iterations, evidence, thresholds, safety and recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Perform read-only platform inventory only. Do not install or execute Memeye until the authenticated procedure defines its behavior.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Semantic definition and safety review completed.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: To be defined by AMD SPEC; package existence or a generic output log is insufficient.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Exact AMD document and measurable limits, not 'match AMD spec'.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not infer the tool function, target DIMMs, use leaked/unverified binaries, clear logs or run a 72-hour unknown operation.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: AMD/FAE and platform owner resolve the test before execution.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Unknown state-changing behavior prevents execution; preserve inventory only.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Absent or unverifiable SPEC/package, undefined target/effect/acceptance/recovery.
